title: Bearing Lite owner feedback record
description: One line of <feedback_dir>/<candidate_digest>/feedback.jsonl, written by tools/plannotator-adapter.mjs outside the frozen plan package. A record is feedback or an approve intent for the existing owner-decision procedure; it never grants authority.

candidate_digest.description: Manifest digest from plan-package draft for the reviewed candidate.

request_id.description: One per review session; shared by every record of that session.

timestamp.description: Adapter clock when the session ended; Plannotator exports no annotation times.

artifact_path.description: Package-relative path of the annotated artifact.

section_id.description: Markdown heading or HTML section id; 'candidate' for an approve intent.

body.description: Owner comment with &, < and > escaped; empty for an approve intent.
